description: This is a Sources Sought Notice Only. The Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC), Dugway Proving Ground (DPG), is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing preventive maintenance, repair, upgrade, and technical support services for Agilent analytical laboratory equipment located at the Combined Chemical Test Facility (CCTF), Chemical Test Division (CTD), Dugway Proving Ground, Utah. Interested vendors shall demonstrate their capability to provide all personnel, supervision, tools, equipment, replacement parts, calibration standards, software/firmware updates, and travel necessary to maintain covered laboratory instrumentation. Services may include preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, equipment upgrades, and technical support. Systems, components, and services provided must meet or exceed OEM manufacturer specifications. Contractors shall utilize genuine Agilent Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) parts or verified equivalent parts for all repairs. The anticipated contract type is Firm-Fixed-Price with a 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods. Responses to this notice will be used for market research purposes only and are not to be construed as a commitment by the Government.
